item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: rt@ryantownley.com
item.content:encoded:
Your privacy is very important to us. Accordingly, we have developed this Policy in order for you to understand how we collect, use, communicate and disclose and make use of personal information. The following outlines our privacy policy.

  • Before or at the time of collecting personal information, we will identify the purposes for which information is being collected.
  • We will collect and use of personal information solely with the objective of fulfilling those purposes specified by us and for other compatible purposes, unless we obtain the consent of the individual concerned or as required by law.
  • We will only retain personal information as long as necessary for the fulfillment of those purposes.
  • We will collect personal information by lawful and fair means and, where appropriate, with the knowledge or consent of the individual concerned.
  • Personal data should be relevant to the purposes for which it is to be used, and, to the extent necessary for those purposes, should be accurate, complete, and up-to-date.
  • We will protect personal information by reasonable security safeguards against loss or theft, as well as unauthorized access, disclosure, copying, use or modification.
  • We will make readily available to customers information about our policies and practices relating to the management of personal information.

We are committed to conducting our business in accordance with these principles in order to ensure that the confidentiality of personal information is protected and maintained.

item.title: How does your licensing work?
item.dc:creator: rt@ryantownley.com
item.content:encoded: Basically, same licensing as StudioPress. You can purchase and use for unlimited number of sites (including client sites). Your purchase entitles you to support but your clients' would need to purchase the theme in question to get direct support.

item.title: What kind of support is included?
item.dc:creator: rt@ryantownley.com
item.content:encoded:
Our themes are a breeze to setup, simple to use, and include no unnecessary bells & whistles which means your need for support should be minimal. We are here to help you with anything related to setup issues or questions, bug fixes, and general questions on how to use the theme. Customization help is not included in the cost of the theme.

Need help or have pre-sales questions? Contact us for help.

item.title: Who do you recommend for web hosting?
item.dc:creator: rt@ryantownley.com
item.content:encoded: We recommend WP Engine for web hosting and when you sign up for a WP Engine plan, you receive the Genesis Framework and 35+ StudioPress Themes free!

item.title: Why Genesis Framework? Is it required?
item.dc:creator: rt@ryantownley.com
item.content:encoded:
Not only do we believe in a minimalist approach to design but also behind the scenes. Genesis Framework provides an extremely clean non-bloated foundation in which to build our themes. Genesis is rock solid, lightning fast, flexible, and provides excellent SEO benefits out-of-the-box.

Genesis Framework is required to use any Minimal Genesis theme and is not included.

item.title: Solid typography is critical to design
item.dc:creator: rt@ryantownley.com
item.content:encoded:
This is a general body paragraph block. The typeface used here is called Lora, available from Google Fonts. Lora is a well-balanced contemporary serif with roots in calligraphy. It is a text typeface with moderate contrast well suited for body text.

Heading 2

A paragraph set in Lora will make a memorable appearance because of its brushed curves in contrast with driving serifs. The overall typographic voice of Lora perfectly conveys the mood of a modern-day story, or an art essay. Technically Lora is optimized for screen appearance, and works equally well in print.

Heading 3

We are pairing Lora with a typeface called Open Sans for headings. Open Sans is a humanist sans serif typeface designed by Steve Matteson, Type Director of Ascender Corp.

Heading 4

Open Sans was designed with an upright stress, open forms and a neutral, yet friendly appearance. It was optimized for print, web, and mobile interfaces, and has excellent legibility characteristics in its letterforms.

Heading 5

This is a general body paragraph block. The typeface used here is called Lora, available from Google Fonts.

Heading 6

Lora is a well-balanced contemporary serif with roots in calligraphy. It is a text typeface with moderate contrast well suited for body text.
